tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od bzhugs so// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams dang lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan zab gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor gser bzang ltar 'bar sku gsum zhal gyis mdzes/ /rtsa zhal gur gum bzang 'dra gzhan dag dbang sngon mdog mtshungs ku mud phreng ltar dkar/ /phyin drug phyag gi yal ga ral gri utpal mda' gzhus legs sbrel gzhan dag gis/ /rang snang 'od kyi yum la legs 'khyud bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan gang gi sgrub thabs kun tu bzang / /rnam gsum ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa las/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rnam gnyis byon pa yi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin go bde'i ngag gis bshad/ /'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pas/ me tog dang 'bab chus brgyan pa'i ri la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su tsandan dmar po'i chus byug cing / dri zhim po'i me tog gi sil mar bkram nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa la don gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi rten dang brten pa'i rnal 'byor/ rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan don du 'gyur ba'i phyir du tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa/ lha bskyed pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa/ bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun dang por rnam thar sgo gsum dran par byas nas gdong dag pa'i rjes sam thun gzhan rnams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi rjes su/

rang skad cig gis dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar a dkar po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ gyi yi ge gur gum gyi mdog lta bu sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo/ de las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad snang bar bsams nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i gtang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ slar yang snying kha'i mam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i dbu la bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas me tog de bzhin du dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gandhes dri/ nai wi dyas zhal zas/ shabdas rol mo dbul/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzrī hūm̐ zhes pas gzugs dang / shabdas sgra/ gandhes dri/ ra sas ro/ sparṣes reg rdo rje ma'i mchod pa phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo las byung ba'i sprul pa'i lus rnams kyis tshogs zhing rnams kyi spyan sngar pus mo btsugs nas/ dpal ldan bde rdzogs zab gsal gnyis med 'od zer ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin zhi ba bcu drug phyed cha 'bar/ /don dam snying po de ston bla ma gsum po rab/

/de la bya byed gsum mnyam pa yis rtag tu 'dud/ /dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing / /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rnam mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta pra ṇa me na badzra bandha naṃ kā ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod de/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje cher ldan de dag spyan sngar ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyis rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems pa dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing / /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu'i dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas chos thams cad ngo bo dang /

rgyu dang / 'bras bus stong pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum mngon du byas nas brtan pa'i ched du/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar lus ngag yid gsum thams cad kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyi bar du chud par bsgoms nas rnal 'byor pa rang gis sems nyid de'i gzugs su langs par bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhūm̐ ser po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che bar bsams la/ de'i dbus dang phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de yang steng gi ser po/ lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus dang 'og tu rdo rje/ steng du 'khor lo/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du rdo rje tho ba dang / rdo rje dbyug pa dang / padma dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / ral gri dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / rtse gsum pa rnams hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer kha dog nag po spros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen po thob ste zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur nas rang rang gi sa bon la zhugs te yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ 'og tu rdo rje gnod mdzes sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug zhal phyag snga ma dang 'dra ba/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/

g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra ba/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri g.yon 'og pa gnyis kyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis snga ma dang 'dra/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ spro na rgyan dang cha lugs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab ste/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/ de rnams kyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ re re/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing / 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha gyes pa'i tshogs kyis lus dang ngag dang yid la gnas pa'i bdud phyung nas phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang /

de'i nang du logs rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / steng du rdo rje'i gur dang / 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ stug cing mkhregs pa/ bar mtshams med pa'i rang bzhin gyi srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ kun tu bzang po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ nor bu dang rin po ches dbur brgyan pa/ rin pa che'i rgyan can/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan mnga' ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas kha dog dkar po zur gsum pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ ser po las byung ba'i sna tshogs padma'i lte bar kham̐ ljang gu las sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba la bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i gzugs su gyur te bhrūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod paṇa mdzes pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan can/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan mnga' ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/

rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang / rnga yab dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dang / steng du rin po che'i drwa mig ser ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ de dag gi bar rnams su rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur rtse bzhir gdugs bzhis mdzes shing / phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gzungs ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / de'i steng du gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i nang du lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su dkyil 'khor nang ma phyi nas 'od zer lngas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i phyi'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzangs dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/

phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i gnas su rab tu rgyas pa'i padma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan bsam mo/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis te/ yan lag dang 'bras bu bzhi chung ngus rje btsun yab dang / de dag 'bring gis rje btsun yum bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ nam mkha'i yi ge gsum gzhal yas khang gi dbus su babs te/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su gnas pa'i ye shes kyis bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzhal yas khang gi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la gzigs par mdzod cig ces bskul bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yi ge gsum gyi gzugs kyis rnal 'byor pa'i lus la zhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas de'i 'og gi char sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis brjod pa g.yas skor g.yon skor du dmigs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shes rab kyi ngo bo nyid du bsam/ yi ge gsum gyi steng gi char dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha na da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod pa g.yas skor g.yon skor du dmigs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa thabs kyi ngo bo nyid du bsams la/ gnyis ka'ang me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsam mo/ /zla ba gnyis ka gcig tu gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las hūm̐ dmar po las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes su bsams la/ oṃ badzra ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo / /hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad rdo rje sems par gyur nas 'od zer gyis bkug ste hūm̐ la thim pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su bsams la/ ya thā sarba ta thā ga tā ta thā a haṃ/ zhes bzla'o/ /slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyis sa bon gyi yi ge hūm̐ la thim/ sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og pa gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul kun tu bzang po bzhin du bsam mo/ de nas 'dod chags chen pos gdul ba'i sems can rnams bde ba chen po'i thabs kyis gdul ba'i phyir du yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra/ nam mkha'i khams gang ba grag pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te/ rje btsun yab rgyas par gyur nas lha mo mnyes par gyur par bsam mo/ /de rnams spyan dang / mā ma kī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / gzugs rdo rje dang / sgra rdo rje dang / dri rdo rje dang / ro rdo rje dang / reg rdo rje'i ngo bor byung ste/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ rje btsun ma'i ba spu'i bu gar zhugs pas yum rgyas par gyur pas rje btsun yab mnyes par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas yab yum gnyis ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/

yab kyi zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar babs pa skad cig gis rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad bkug dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs te bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam mo/ /slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab gyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ sems can gyi tshogs de rnams la dbang bskur bas de rnams kyi dbang po drug yul drug 'byung ba bzhi/ phung po lnga rnams zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur/ de las kṣiṃ/ dzrīṃ/ kham̐/ gam̐ ṣkam̐/ sam̐/ dzam̐ḥhūm̐ bam̐ ham̐/ kham̐/ ram̐/ lam̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ bum̐/ ām̐/ dzrīṃ/ kham̐/ hūm̐ rnams kyi sa bon dang phyag mtshan las byung ba'i sa'i snying po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' drug gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo drug spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma bzhi/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa bha ga nas mtha' yas par spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi pha'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa'o/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'jug pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rab tu mi rtog rnyog med pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pas ched du brjod de bsam gyis mi khyab par spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don byas par bsam mo/

/slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas nam mkha' nas hoḥdamar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i yi ge gsum yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar babs pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis ka 'od du zhu ste byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas thig le las spros pa'i lha mo bzhi rang rang gi gnas su 'dug nas glus bskul te/ mā ma kīs/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor los sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rab tu phan bzhed ston/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pa bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag ni don dang dgos pa mdzad par rab tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /dga' ba spyod pa kun tu bzang po bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan yon che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid thugs brtse ba/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bskul bas thig le de mam̐ las gser gyi yu ba can gyi ral gri ljang khu yu ba la mam̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen po thob par gyur te/

'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i gzugs kyis mam̐ gyi yi ge la thim/ ral gri mam̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo gur gum gyi mdog lta bu/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri ljang gu dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal sngon po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu rgyan can/ sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes bya bas chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa nyer sgrub dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ mig gnyis kyi dbus su kṣiṃ las 'khor lo kṣiṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rna bar dzrīṃ las rdo rje dzrīṃ gyis mtshan par yongs su gyur pa las phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ snar kham̐ las rin po che kham̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las nam snying ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ lcer gam̐ las padma gam̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar sngon dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams su ṣkaṃ las ral gri ṣkaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sgrib sel ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ lte bar sam̐ las rdo rje sam̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul thams cad gtso bo dang mtshungs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa sgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi phyag mtshan phyag rdor dang mtshungs pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po zhal phyag 'jig rten dbang phyug dang mtshungs pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po zhal phyag sa snying dang mtshungs par bsgom mo/ /thugs rdo rje'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dka'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐ las spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma phyung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bstod nas rig ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus la zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bskul bar bya ste/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/

/rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje bdag gi thugs rdo rje la zhugs par bsam mo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje bdag nyid kyi thugs rdo rje la thim par bsam mo/ /gsung rdo rje ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge āḥlas spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma phyung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bstod nas rig ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus la zhugs te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bskul bar bya ste/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje bdag gi gsung rdo rje la zhugs par bsam mo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje bdag nyid kyi gsung rdo rje la thim par bsam mo/ /sku'i rdo rje'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge oṃ las spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma phyung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bstod nas rig ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus la zhugs te/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bskul bar bya ste/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje rang gi sku rdo rje la zhugs par bsam mo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa wa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje bdag nyid kyi sku rdo rje la thim par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po dang bral ba'i 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du mam̐ las ral gri mam̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas mam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mam̐ yig gur gum gyi mdog lta bu de las 'od zer 'phros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i rig mas bum pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ni sarba artha sā dha ni swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ ka ri/ shāntaṃ ka ri ghu ṭa ghu ṭa ghu ṭi ni/ gha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya ghu ṭi ni swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe ka ro ṭa birye swāhā/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha mo rnams spyi bor thim pas/ gtso bo la mi skyod pa/ sku rdo rje dang sa snying la rnam snang /

thugs rdo rje dang / ye shes sems dpa' dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / kun tu bzang po la mi bskyod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas/ sgrib pa rnam sel la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa yan lag dang 'bras bu 'bring bzhis rje btsun yum bskyed pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'bring ni/ rang gi mdun du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rnal 'byor pa rang nyid yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su gnas pa'i ye shes kyis bskul bas zhes pa nas mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed/ de nas 'gro ba dbang bskur gyi bar rnams dor nas nam mkha'i yi ge lnga po zhugs pa nas zhu ba dang / glus bskul ba dang / de las 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar bzhengs te zhal phyag gsal gdab pa'i bar snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyer sgrub dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'bring dang / gsum pa sgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu 'bring dang / bzhi pa sgrub chen dang dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu 'bring ni snga ma ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ yum gyi spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ yig dkar po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo mgrin pa yan chad du khyab pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ yig nag po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo nu ma'i bar du khyab pa/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la swā yig ser po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo sum mdo'i bar du khyab pa/ padma'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥyig dmar po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo brla la thug par khyab pa/ byin pa gnyis la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hā yig ljang gu rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo rkang pa'i bar du khyab par bsgoms te/ 'dis lha mo rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur to/

/de nas yab kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i bug par phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi padma hūm̐ las padma dmar po āḥlas byung ba'i ze'u 'bru'i bug par phaṭa ser pos bkag par bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu chen po ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg ste/ bde ba chen po thob nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal du zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur nas rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas padmar lhung ba yongs su gyur pa las sa bon mam̐ gyi yi ger gyur/ de las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor cig char du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas badzra dhrika ces pas mkha' nang gi mi bskyod pa phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ zhe sdang chen po bskyed pa'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin rang gi lus la thim par bsam mo/ /dzi na dzika ces pas/ mkha' nang gi rnam par snang mdzad phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas gti mug gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig du 'dus nas gti mug chen po bskyed par byed pa'i gzugs kyi phung po dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo shar phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ ratna dhṛka ces pas/ mkha' nang gi rin 'byung phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas nga rgyal gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas te/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas nga rgyal chen po bskyed par byed pa'i tshor ba'i phung po dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin lho phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ ā ro l̥ka ces pas/ mkha' nang gi snang ba mtha' yas phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas 'dod chags gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas 'dod chags chen po bskyed par byed pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin nub phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ 'od dpag med dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kun la 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ pra dzña dhṛka ces pas/ mkha' nang gi don grub phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas phrag dog gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas phrag dog chen po bskyed par byed pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po dang / bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin byang phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ don grub ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyi nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/

rin po che'i rgyan dang / sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /mo ha ra ti zhes pa'i sngags brjod pas mkha' nang gi spyan ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi zhi ba'i las mdzad/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas ring du song ba'i sa rnam par dag pa sa'i khams dang / snying rje chen po dang / stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin me'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ dwe ṣa ra ti zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi mā ma ki phyir spros de dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi srung ba'i las mdzad/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas mi g.yo ba'i sa rnam par dag pa chu'i khams dang / byams pa chen po dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin srin po'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ mā ma kī sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rā ga ra ti zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi gos dkar mo phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad rgyas par byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas sa legs pa'i blo gros rnam par dag pa me'i khams dang / dga' ba chen po dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin rlung gi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi phyag lhag ma 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba/ badzra ra ti zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi sgrol ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad dbang du byas/

slar gcig tu 'dus nas chos kyi sprin gyi sa rnam par dag pa rlung gi khams dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin dbang ldan gyi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ sgrol ma ser mo ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi gzugs rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas ser sna gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba rnam par dag pa ser sna'i gnyen po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin phyi rol me'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pas me long / zhal phyag lhag ma rnam snang dang 'dra ba'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi sgra rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas dri ma med pa'i sa rnam par dag pa 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin srin po'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis pi waṃ dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi dri rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag du med par gyur nas khro ba gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur nas 'od byed pa'i sa rnam par dag pa khro ba'i gnyen po bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i rang bzhin rlung gi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/

dri rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dri'i dung dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi ro rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas le lo gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas 'od 'phro ba'i sa rnam par dag pa le lo'i gnyen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i rang bzhin dbang ldan gyi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi reg rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas g.yeng ba gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas sbyang dka' ba'i sa rnam par dag pa g.yeng ba'i gnyen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin shar sgo'i byang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ reg rdo rje ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis sna tshogs pa'i gos dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ mkha' nang gi chos dbyings rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas shes rab 'chal ba gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas mngon du gyur pa'i sa rnam par dag pa shes rab 'chal ba'i gnyen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin shar sgo'i lho phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis chos 'byung dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu rgyan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs gsol ba/ zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od yod pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'byin sngags 'di dag kun bzang che ba na yod pa bzhin bris pa yin la/ mar me mdzad kyis 'byin sngags la de nyid gsum gyi spel ba bshad pa ltar na rū pa badzrī sogs drug gis kyang rung ngo / /oṃ āḥya manta krita hūm̐ zhes pas mkha' nang gi gshin rje'i gshed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas ma dad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas ma dad pa dang / phung po'i bdud dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po dad pa gtso bor gyur pa shar sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og pa gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥpra dzñān ta krita hūm̐ zhes pas mkha' nang gi shes rab mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas le lo gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas le lo dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / log par lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa lho sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon sngar dang 'dra/ oṃ āḥpadmānta krita hūm̐ zhes pas mkha' nang gi padma mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas brjed nges gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/

slar cig tu 'dus nas brjed nges pa dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / skye ba'i sgrib pa dang / mthar 'dzin par lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po dran pa gtso bor gyur pa nub sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ padma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma rgyas pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥbighnān ta krita hūm̐ zhes pas mkha' nang gi bgegs mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas rnam g.yeng gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas rnam par g.yeng ba dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gtso bor gyur pa byang sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang g.yon brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dgod cing khros pa'i zhal dang ljags 'gyu ba/ nyi ma'i 'od dang spyan zlum po g.yo ba/ khro gnyer gyi zhal can/ che zhing mkhrang la stug pa/ brang dang gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thung zhing sbom pa/ 'bar ba'i skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon mam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros gshin rje'i gshed la reg pas/ des dzaḥzhes brjod pas gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥya mānta krita dzaḥzhes brjod/ de nas rang gi g.yon du sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor gsum gyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/

mchod yon/ zhabs bsil rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsams la/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐ zhes pas dung dang po'i chu dang / oṃ āḥbighnān ta krita hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lan gnyis brjod pas dung gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i chu byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas ye shes pa la gsang gtor dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil phul te/ sngar bzhin rdo rje ma lngas kyang mchod do/ /slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros khro bo gzhan gsum la reg pas/ de dag gi so so'i sngags hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥrnams brjod de/ de dag so so'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams dam tshig pa la thim pa dang / bcing ba dang / mnyes par byas par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥpradzñanta krita hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadmānta krita bam̐/ oṃ āḥbighnānta krita hoḥ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa nye bar sgrub pa dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chen po ni sngar ltar mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chen po ni sngar ltar thugs la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen dang dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu chen po ni/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang / sngar ltar mchod cing gsol ba btab nas dbang bskur bas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rigs bdag mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma dang / gzugs rdo rje dang / gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ mā ma kī dang / sgra rdo rje dang / chos dbyings rdo rje dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed la mi bskyod pa/ gos dkar mo dang / ro rdo rje dang / rta mgrin la 'od dpag med/

reg rdo rje la don grub/ sgrol ma dang / dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon mam̐ yig las 'od zer spros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste zhal nas zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar lhung ste/ zla ba'i gdan bcu la dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ kham̐ ram̐/ lam̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ rnams su gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcur gyur pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros te bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing tshogs zhing gis skabs ltar nyer spyod dang / rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas mchod bya mchod byed gnyis su med par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bstod bya bstod byed gnyis su med par bsams la/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi phyed rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /de nas bdud rtsi dngos su yod pa'am med na bsams kyang rung ste/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan dang bcas shing yam̐ gis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du shar du dri chen la bhrūm̐/ lhor rakta la ām̐/ nub tu byang sems dkar po la dzrīṃ/ byang du sha chen gyi dwangs ma la kham̐/ dbus su dri chu la hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ sa bon de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug nas rang rang gi sa bon la bcug ste/ de'i rkyen gyis 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / dros pa dang / lhags par gyur par bsam mo/ /de'i rlangs pa la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lan gsum spros te zhugs/ de'i steng du oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste/ yi ge oṃ la thim/ oṃ yig kyang zhu ste bdud rtsi la thim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ de'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi gsol bar bsam zhing / lha bcu dgu'i sngags brjod de bdud rtsi phul ba'i snying ga'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor tshim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la bzhi las/ dang po thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ des sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su byas nas tshur 'dus sa bon mam̐ yig la thim/ mam̐ gyi yi ge de thig ler gyur pa'i nang du rnal 'byor pa'i sems zhugs nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa nas ting nge 'dzin gsum ka skad cig mas bsgom ste/ de'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer byung bas ral gri'i yu ba dang / ye shes sems dpa'i lus dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / gzhal yas khang dang /

dam tshig sems dpa'i lus dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / gzhal yas khang rnams gsal bar byas nas phyi rol du song ste 'gro ba thams cad gsal bar byas nas/ slar log ste/ sngar gyi rim pas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon mam̐ yig la thim ste de lta bu'i spro ba dang / bsdu ba yang yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal du zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa padma'i nang du lhung ba las ral gri nas kyi tshad tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su hūm̐ gi sa bon las mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i rim pas gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i rje btsun rdo rje sems dpar gyur te/ gnyis ka mnyes pa la sogs pa'i cho gas thig le'i rnal 'byor la thug gi bar skad cig gis bsgrubs nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngar bzhin spro ba dang bsdu bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su sku rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin pa padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge āḥral gri'i yu ba'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar ral gri'i yu ba'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge mam̐/ snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus su thugs rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ bsams nas/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas te/ 'di la dmigs pa'i bye brag gi rim gyis bzlas pa dang / cig char bzlas pa'i tshul gnyis gsungs so/ /kun bzang che chung dang / jo bo rje'i gzhung rnams las 'di tsam zhig las gzhan bzlas pa mi snang yang /

bod dag oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka hūm̐ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥbi ghnān ta krita hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar rang rang gi sngags de nyid gsum gyis spel ba bzlas pa yang bzhed pa ni bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ yang na rang gi lha yi 'bum/ /gzhan gyi khri ste yang na ni/ /'khor lo can gyi bka' gnad bri/ /'byin pa de nyid gsum dang spel/ /gzhan dag snying po'i sa bon spel/ /ming gi yi ge dang po ni/ /klad skor bcas pas sngags rnams su/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don du snang ngo / /de nas thun las langs par 'dod pa na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdus la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis smon lam 'di gdab bo/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mgon/ /rnal 'byor gyis thob dge ba gang / /bde chen ye shes rang byung nas/ /sems can kun mkhyen sar 'god shog /gang zhig 'di mthong 'dod pa'ang / /gang zhig zhu bar 'dod pa des/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug grangs med pa/ /mgon po de 'dra mthong bar shog /nam mkha'i mtha' klas phyogs bcu ru/ /sems can kun gyi don spyod la/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /bdag gis kyang ni mthong bar shog /ji srid thog ma med pa nas/ /'khor ba yi ni mthar thug bar/ /de srid sems can phan pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa bdag spyod shog /ji srid sangs rgyas sna tshogs rnams/ /'jig rten gnyen bshes mya ngan 'das/ /de ni bstan pa'i don du ni/ /bskal pa'i bskal par byed par shog /rdo rje 'chang sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag gis phyogs bcur sprul gyur cig /sngags kyi tshul gyis sems can mchog /de tshe bdag gis 'dul gyur cig /bzhi pa tshim pa'i cho ga ni/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can yam̐ gis mtshan pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor bum pa la bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po la ram̐ gis mtshan pa bsams la/
